items.description:
Themolo Business Enterprise is a Garsfontein-based construction and facilities management company describing itself as an emerging player in the construction field. The business says its policy is to deliver superior-quality projects to each client's specification at economically feasible prices, aiming to build a reputation for reliability and quality workmanship within the construction industry.

Beyond construction project delivery, Themolo has built up close to two decades of experience within the built environment and facilities management sector, positioning itself as a provider of technical skills across the full range of facilities management work. Its disciplines in this area include mechanical and electrical maintenance and engineering, environmental health and safety management, and energy and project management, services aimed primarily at commercial and industrial clients that need ongoing building and infrastructure support alongside new construction work.

TILT INTERACTIVE, based in Rietvalleirand, describes itself as a design collective rather than a conventional agency, assembling specialist talent on a project-by-project basis rather than keeping a fixed in-house team. For projects that call for it, the business brings in additional developers or language editors so that specific client goals can be met without being limited to a single set of in-house skills.

Its stated niche is independent professionals, including authors, artists, entrepreneurs and engineers, alongside corporations that want a considered creative approach. Portfolio work shown by the business spans website design, logo design, packaging design, and animation and video production, with case studies and project rates presented alongside its services pages for prospective clients evaluating its design and development work.

items.description:
Toncrete is a ready-mix concrete business operating from Klerksoord in Akasia. Its services are built around three core offerings: concrete slab supply, concrete pumping, and ready-mix concrete delivery.

For slab work, the business emphasises producing long-lasting, properly poured concrete slabs rather than treating the job as straightforward, noting that getting professional help makes a real difference to the result. Its concrete pumping service covers a wide range of applications, including foundations, roads, parking lots, driveways and drainage systems, positioning the business as a dedicated supplier for both structural and civil concrete needs. Across its ready-mix concrete work, Toncrete says it places a strong emphasis on consistent product and service quality, aiming to build long-lasting relationships with the customers it supplies rather than one-off transactions.

items.description:
Tseba Business Accountants, operating from Florauna in Pretoria North, positions itself as a preferential service provider built around the quality of service it delivers and the manner in which it is delivered. The firm's stated mission is to serve clients professionally and with integrity, while its goals centre on providing excellent service in a cost-efficient way and on developing lasting relationships that come from genuinely understanding each client's business.

Its core values are listed as professionalism, integrity, quality service, trust and respect. On the services side, Tseba Business Accountants offers accounting, taxation and payroll services alongside secretarial services and broader business consulting and advisory support, aiming to cover the day-to-day compliance needs of individual and small to medium business clients as well as longer-term strategic guidance.

items.description:
Twist Electrical Supplies, with its Montana Park branch serving Pretoria North, operates as part of a wholesaler also present in Rosslyn and in Langebaan in the Western Cape. The business opened its doors in July 2011 and has traded continuously as an electrical wholesaler in the north of Pretoria since then.

It stocks a wide range of electrical products and accessories aimed at industrial, commercial and domestic customers, with a client base that spans the construction industry, electrical contractors, commercial operations and ordinary households. The company says its approach is built on long-term relationships with reputable suppliers, which it uses to keep costs down, stay flexible and respond quickly as customer requirements change. Its stated vision is to become the leading electrical wholesaler in the north of Pretoria while growing into a more broadly competitive player in the wholesale electrical industry.

Ultimate Labour Solutions, based in Doornpoort, offers tailor-made labour relations and human resource services built around a team the firm describes as having more than 80 years of combined experience across labour relations, business administration and investigative legal services. It positions itself as a single point of contact for forensic investigations and legal support connected to workplace disputes, working with both employers and employees rather than one side only. Its listed services cover labour relations and industrial relations matters, human resources consulting, and divorce legal services, giving the practice a reach beyond pure employment law.

The firm states that it has achieved a 99% success rate guiding employers through labour disputes, while also extending support to employees dealing with difficult workplace situations. Ultimate Labour Solutions describes its approach as grounded in strict business ethics and lawful conduct, with client matters handled with integrity throughout the process.

V4 Marketing, based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, is a creative marketing, design and sales company founded in 2021 to help businesses grow through visual branding, strategic planning and online sales support. The agency connects business goals with creative execution across four main service areas: marketing strategy, where it builds targeted plans aimed at reaching the right audience with the right message; branding and design, covering logos, visual identities and websites; content and social media, built around storytelling intended to build trust and engagement; and online sales and campaigns, supporting both e-commerce and service-based businesses with systems meant to boost sales performance. The company describes its core values as listening closely to understand each client's goals, paying close attention to detail, applying creativity rooted in strategy rather than just appearance, communicating honestly, and treating every project as a partnership measured by the growth it helps create for the client.

Valley Falls Spur operates from Shop 94 at Irene Village Mall on Mezereon Crescent in Irene Farm Villages, as part of the nationwide Spur Steak Ranches family restaurant chain. The branch offers table bookings for diners who want to reserve ahead of a visit, alongside standard walk-in, sit-down dining.

For customers who prefer not to eat in, it provides a range of ordering and collection options, including call-and-order and in-app ordering, plus its own collection and delivery service, as well as third-party delivery through Mr Delivery and Uber Eats. This spread of dine-in, take-away, collection and delivery choices reflects the chain's broader approach of making its steakhouse menu accessible to both sit-down diners and customers wanting food delivered to home or office in the Irene and wider Centurion area.

Van Niekerk Attorneys Inc, operating from Kameeldrift, is a Pretoria law firm focused on personal injury and corporate and commercial litigation as its core areas of practice. The firm describes its foundation as resting on client advocacy and legal integrity, with a track record it says has brought recognition for impactful litigation and dispute-resolution strategies over the course of its operation.

Van Niekerk Attorneys Inc serves a client base that includes individuals, families and corporate entities, and says it places particular emphasis on understanding each client's specific legal needs so that it can offer tailored solutions and representation rather than a standardised approach. The firm highlights its experience handling complex legal challenges and says it has built a loyal clientele through long-term relationships, positioning itself as an established litigation practice for personal and business legal matters in the Pretoria area.

items.description:
VINDit is a Kameelfontein-based online platform, established in 2025, built to help local businesses in the area connect with their community and be found more easily by potential customers. The idea behind the platform grew out of a problem its founders identified: businesses often struggle to be visible and accessible to the people who might use them. VINDit addresses this by giving companies of all sizes a space to showcase their services, share their contact details and make themselves easy to find online.

Beyond business listings, the platform also surfaces local happenings such as music festivals, local markets and parkrun events, positioning itself as a hub for what is going on nearby as well as a business directory. Although inspired by the entrepreneurial spirit of the local Laerskool Kameelfontein community, VINDit was founded as a fully independent company with its own identity and purpose.

items.description:
Wannenburg's Hermanstad branch is part of a motor spares business with more than 60 years of experience as a dismantler of accident-damaged vehicles across Pretoria. The company operates four branches in the city, of which Hermanstad is one, and specialises in selling new and used motor spares for all vehicle makes and models.

Alongside selling new replacement parts and second-hand parts, the business buys accident-damaged vehicles that are still repairable, dismantling them to recover usable components, and also sells rebuilt vehicles. It positions itself as a resource for vehicle owners deciding how to deal with a damaged car, offering to buy vehicles directly as an alternative to owners trying to sell a damaged vehicle privately. The business describes its focus as providing affordable, high-quality replacement parts drawn from its long-standing experience in the motor spares trade.

Wapadrand Medical Centre, founded in 1998, describes itself as a family health hub offering comprehensive care built around a holistic approach rather than treating isolated symptoms. Its multi-disciplinary team is structured to look at patients as a whole, bringing together different kinds of medical and allied-health support under one practice. Services offered from its Wapadrand premises include general medical consultations, physiotherapy, psychology and dietetic services, alongside aesthetic treatments, giving patients access to several disciplines without needing to be referred elsewhere for related care.

The practice says its approach is guided by core values of integrity, respect, collaboration and responsibility, and that its holistic grouping of services is intended to ensure patients receive well-rounded, multi-disciplinary attention rather than a single-issue consultation. The centre presents this combined-services model as its main point of difference from a standard single-discipline medical practice.

Webbi, based in Eldoraigne, is a digital agency offering website design and development alongside broader marketing services. Its web work includes building Shopify e-commerce stores and custom HTML5 and CSS3 sites on the Bootstrap framework, built to be fully responsive across devices. Beyond websites, the agency produces graphic design and branding work such as logos, labels, flyers, brochures, email marketing material, website graphics, digital advertisements and social media channel art.

On the marketing side, Webbi runs Facebook advertising campaigns that it says are tracked through to leads and sales rather than measured only by likes or engagement, with some campaigns generating leads within the first 24 hours of launch. It also offers search engine optimisation, which it describes as a slower but high-converting channel best suited to businesses that already have some consistent leads and sales, and pay-per-click advertising through Google Ads to complement its SEO work.

items.description:
Wonders Christian Preschool operates on Boshoff Street in The Orchards as a faith-based early childhood education provider. Its programme combines structured learning with engaging activities designed to support young children's development, delivered in small classes intended to keep the learning environment nurturing and manageable for young learners. The preschool's stated focus is on supporting social, cognitive and emotional growth together, rather than concentrating on academic content alone, reflecting an approach aimed at the whole child rather than one area of development.

The school presents itself as combining a faith-based ethos with early learning fundamentals, aiming to create a warm, supportive atmosphere for children in the surrounding Orchards community of Pretoria. Parents are able to arrange a tour of the preschool to see the small-class, faith-based approach in practice before enrolling.

items.description:
Wysa Engineering Services, operating from Highway Business Park in Rooihuiskraal, provides CNC machining and manufacturing services to a range of industries. The company's team of engineers, draughtsmen and technicians is focused on producing precision parts and components built to each client's exact specifications, supported by ongoing investment in up-to-date machining equipment and software and continued staff training. Final inspection on components is carried out using measuring equipment calibrated to SANAS specification, and the business runs an inventory and tooling system it calls 'Matrix', through which all tools and measuring equipment used on a job are logged to maintain traceability on every component it produces.

Wysa describes its approach as combining high-end machinery with strict compliance procedures, aiming to tackle complex machining projects and deliver innovative solutions for clients' manufacturing needs. The company also says it continually works to improve its manufacturing processes and costs by applying Industry 4.0 principles across its operations.

Ysterman Safety and Security CC, based in Klerksoord, Akasia, specialises in custom steel manufacturing alongside powder coating and sandblasting services. Its custom steel manufacturing work covers bespoke solutions designed around each client's needs, whether that calls for intricate decorative designs or more robust structural steelwork. The business designs and manufactures security gates intended to combine strength and durability with a finished, aesthetic appearance, with gates custom-made to suit the specific security requirements of residential, commercial and industrial properties.

Alongside its manufacturing work, Ysterman offers a professional sandblasting service used to clean and prepare metal surfaces before further treatment, removing rust, old paint and other contaminants so the surface is left smooth and ready to accept specialised coatings or other follow-on applications. Together, these services position the business as a combined steel fabrication, security-gate and surface-preparation provider for Pretoria's northern suburbs.

Yuri Property is a residential estate agency focused specifically on the Pretoria East market, including Woodhill Golf Estate and the surrounding suburbs. Rather than running a large call-centre style operation, the agency positions itself around a single, direct point of contact for buyers and renters, built on local neighbourhood knowledge of Pretoria East rather than a citywide generalist approach.

Prospective buyers and tenants can search for homes by criteria such as budget, number of bedrooms, estate living and lifestyle preferences before dealing directly with the agency once they are ready to move forward. At the time of research, Yuri Property described its listings as still being prepared, inviting people to register their property search so they can be notified as suitable homes become available, both for sale and to rent, across established family suburbs and secure estates in the Pretoria East area.

items.description:
ZGS Security Services, based in Sinoville, is a security services provider covering Pretoria's northern suburbs, including areas such as Sinoville, Annlin, Montana and Montana Park. The company installs and maintains alarm systems, CCTV, two-way radios and panic systems, and also offers armed reaction services for clients who need an active response to a triggered alarm.

Beyond on-site installations, ZGS runs a large, continuously staffed control room that provides off-site camera monitoring for a number of clients, allowing properties to be watched remotely rather than relying only on local alarm response. The business also supplies gate automation equipment as part of its broader product and service range, rounding out its offering for residential and commercial properties that want both physical access control and electronic monitoring handled by the same provider.

items.description:
Zone Chemicals was established in February 1997 by two chemical engineers with more than twenty years of combined experience, who set out as a two-person team to manufacture and supply chemical solutions that were high quality but still affordable. The company has since grown to employ more than a hundred people, with a national footprint that includes branches in Pretoria, KwaZulu-Natal and Cape Town alongside its Rosslyn operation. It initially specialised in manufacturing and distributing industrial chemical products for the metal, paper and water treatment industries, and has since expanded into a range covering most industries, including auto care, contract cleaning, education, facilities management, farming, food preparation, healthcare and hospitality, as well as domestic use.

Alongside its own chemical formulations, the business supplies a range of consumables, from brushware to paper products, and says it develops tailor-made solutions for clients' specific problem areas rather than only offering a standard catalogue. Zone Chemicals is a member of the National Contract Cleaners Association.

1 Online Digital Marketing, based in Les Marais, is a web design and digital marketing agency built around small and medium-sized South African businesses rather than corporate budgets. Its core offering is a subscription-based, month-to-month web design service with no long-term contracts, intended to remove the large upfront cost usually associated with building a website.

Alongside web design, the agency runs search engine optimisation aimed at ranking client businesses on the first page of search results for revenue-generating search terms, and manages Google Ads campaigns it describes as closely controlled pay-per-click advertising meant to avoid wasted ad spend. It also offers social media content and community management services. The agency says it maintains a 98% client retention rate across more than 150 projects, and treats transparent, detailed reporting as central to how it works with clients, so businesses can see exactly what their marketing spend is achieving each month.

1stop4u is an online retailer based in Erasmia selling a mix of consumer electronics, clothing, children's sneakers and safety equipment. Its electronics range includes items such as multi-function wireless chargers that combine iPhone and AirPods charging with a portable Bluetooth speaker and touch lamp, smart home accessories such as infrared Wi-Fi universal remote controls, and security products including waterproof fingerprint smart padlocks.

The store also stocks higher-value electronics such as laptops, including configurations built around Intel i7 processors with solid-state storage and full-HD displays, alongside its lower-priced accessory lines. By combining everyday electronic accessories with clothing, children's footwear and safety equipment under one storefront, 1stop4u positions itself as a general online shopping destination for South African consumers rather than a specialist retailer limited to one product category.

3% Properties - Parris Inc. is a real estate law practice based in the Clydesdale area of central Pretoria. The firm's work centres on property transactions, offering contract reviews, title checks and due diligence for buyers, sellers and anyone registering a property transfer. Its attorneys are described as experienced in guiding clients through purchases, sales and registrations, aiming to simplify what can otherwise be a complicated and paperwork-heavy process.

The practice presents its approach as professional and client-focused, built around giving clear, efficient guidance rather than leaving clients to interpret legal documents on their own. Consultations at the Clydesdale office are available on weekdays from eight in the morning until four-thirty in the afternoon, giving clients a defined window in which to meet with an attorney about an ongoing or upcoming property transaction.

A2M Management & Business Consultants, based in Brummeria, was set up to provide business coaching to small and medium-sized businesses that could not afford the fees charged by mainstream coaching and consulting firms but still needed structured help to grow. Its work is organised around a set of named focus areas: visioning, training, planning, marketing, coaching, hiring, networking and operations, covering both the strategic and day-to-day sides of running a business.

The consultancy describes business coaching as a relationship between a business owner and a coach, where the coach's role is to help the owner design a vision for the business that lines up with their personal values and goals, and then provide ongoing guidance, support and accountability as the owner works toward those goals. This framing positions A2M as a coaching-led consultancy rather than a firm offering only one-off strategic reports.

AB Aboo and Company is a multi-disciplinary firm of chartered accountants, registered auditors and other professionals based in Laudium. The firm offers a comprehensive range of specialist accounting, auditing, advisory and tax services across a broad variety of business sectors, with a client base that spans national corporations, private businesses, nonprofits, emerging or start-up firms and individuals. Its service lines cover accounting, audit and assurance, business advisory, payroll, secretarial work and taxation, giving clients a single firm for both day-to-day compliance and more specialist advisory needs.

AB Aboo and Company describes itself as built on principles of professionalism and integrity, serving as a valued advisor to clients on operational and financial matters that affect their broader business goals. The firm says it concentrates on quality relationships rather than volume of clients, placing its emphasis on building long-term relationships rather than simply growing its client list as quickly as possible.

items.description:
Allemans Concrete Walls has been installing and supplying concrete walls in Klerksoord for around 30 years. The business sells concrete wall material directly to the public and offers a full range of related services, including installing new concrete walls, extending existing walls, and relocating or shifting walls that need to be moved rather than rebuilt from scratch. It also installs 'ZoZo house' and tool-shed structures built from the same concrete wall panel system, and produces small GFRC pots and planters alongside its wall products.

Its featured product range includes concrete panels, klinker posts, paving blocks, stepping stones, and both standard and klinker-style concrete walling, along with wall extension components. The business suggests its walling can be used for several purposes beyond simple boundary fencing, including creating an enclosed vegetable garden, walling off sections of a property, or providing privacy around a swimming pool.

AMST (Asset Management Solutions Technologies), based in Clubview, focuses on fleet security and risk prevention for businesses, combining technology with security expertise to deliver asset-protection solutions for companies of varying sizes. One of its core offerings is electronic locking solutions, an approach to securing vehicles and assets that the company positions as improving security while also supporting day-to-day operational efficiency rather than simply locking equipment down. AMST also provides advanced vehicle monitoring and remote surveillance systems, intended to let businesses keep track of assets and manage risk regardless of where those assets are located.

Beyond vehicle-focused services, the company builds tailor-made on-site camera rooms using current surveillance technology, and offers retail and commercial guarding services aimed at keeping client premises secure. Together, these services position AMST as a combined provider of electronic, physical and monitoring-based security for commercial fleet and asset protection.

items.description:
Army Surplus Stores has traded in Pretoria West since 1970, making it one of the longer-established outdoor and military-surplus retailers in the city. Its range runs well beyond basic army surplus stock, covering camping and tents, catering supplies, outdoor clothing and footwear, and steel beds and storage items.

The tent range alone spans PVC and canvas pole tents in a wide variety of sizes, from small canvas bow tents suitable for a weekend trip up to large PVC pole tents designed for bigger gatherings or events, alongside budget-oriented polyethylene pole tents and clear pyramid tents. Alongside outdoor cooking and dining equipment for campers and caterers, the store stocks outdoor clothing and footwear and a range of steel beds and bedding. The business now also offers nationwide delivery with secure online checkout, extending its reach well beyond customers able to visit the Pretoria West store in person.
